description: Calculate drywall sheets needed for walls, walls + ceiling, or a known surface area across 4×8, 4×10, 4×12 ft and metric sheets.

area.description: Known surface area (ft² in us, m² in metric) when kind="area".

height.description: Wall height (ft in us, default 8; m in metric, default 2.4).

kind.description: "walls" for walls only, "room" for walls + ceiling, "area" for known area.

length.description: Room length (ft in us, m in metric).

openingsArea.description: Total door/window area to subtract (ft² in us, m² in metric).

width.description: Room width (ft in us, m in metric).

name: calculate_drywall
title: Drywall Calculator
